decisions.reason: After a second year on the market and the withdrawal of the separate shuttering and de-shuttering robots, the combined robot appears to be the firm's preferred integrated automation option, so it remains worth keeping with only moderate residual downside.

The profile storage robot is still a narrower complementary module, so the firm would keep the option open within its broad system portfolio but with a clearly higher chance of withdrawal if project demand remains limited.

As a newly launched multi-model line that extends the firm's process-automation offer, uncertainty has not yet resolved and the option value of keeping it on the market is likely greater than its carrying cost.

Production analysis software fits the firm's software, controls, and lifecycle-support strategy and is relatively inexpensive to continue offering while adoption and cross-selling potential are still being tested.
